kinds.mpsc: apply ops in order to one channel; expected[i] is the outcome of ops[i]
kinds.oneshot: apply ops in order to one oneshot channel; expected[i] is the outcome of ops[i]
kinds.join_all: join_all over tasks; expected is {ok: values} or {error: message}
kinds.select: select over tasks; expected is {index, value} or {error: message}
kinds.timeout: timeout(deadline_ms, task); expected is {ok: value}, "timeout" or {error: message}
